title: Alignment Verifiability in Large Language Models: Normative Indistinguishability under Behavioral Evaluation
reasoning: The entire paper focuses on the formal verification of 'alignment,' which in AI refers to ensuring models adhere to human values, morals, and normative ethics. It specifically introduces the concept of 'Normative Indistinguishability' to discuss the limits of testing a model's latent ethical and normative properties.
